principles: Audience gold is an independent human observation, not the requested generation target.
Factual/concept preservation is non-compensatory: readability or audience fit cannot compensate material factual or concept loss.
Format-native checks use canonical executable contracts when applicable.
Mixed or broken outputs may be UNSCORABLE rather than forced into a class.

audience_global_labels.BEGINNER: Assumes little financial background; explains required jargon in plain language or everyday analogy; emphasizes what it is, why it matters, and practical impact while preserving material concepts.
audience_global_labels.INTERMEDIATE: Assumes core financial concepts; uses standard market vocabulary with moderate contextualization; connects drivers, trends and interpretation/allocation without requiring specialist methodology.
audience_global_labels.ADVANCED: Assumes technical/institutional repertoire; preserves precise technical terminology and analytical depth, including conditionals, trade-offs and methodology when material.
audience_global_labels.UNSCORABLE: Truncated, incoherent, internally mixed beyond a dominant class, or otherwise unsuitable for a defensible audience-level label.

audience_dimensions.question: How much unexplained domain jargon/background is assumed?

anchors.0_BEGINNER_LIKE: Required jargon is absent or immediately explained/analogized.
anchors.1_INTERMEDIATE_LIKE: Standard market terms are usable with moderate contextualization.
anchors.2_ADVANCED_LIKE: Precise technical jargon is preserved and used correctly without introductory explanation when specialist context makes that reasonable.

audience_dimensions.question: What level of financial/institutional background is assumed?
What analytical depth is required to follow the piece?

anchors.2_ADVANCED_LIKE: Methodology, conditionals, causal structure, trade-offs and technical nuance.

audience_dimensions.question: What is the dominant explanatory focus?

anchors.0_BEGINNER_LIKE: What it is / why it matters / practical impact.
anchors.1_INTERMEDIATE_LIKE: How to interpret / trends / portfolio or market context.
anchors.2_ADVANCED_LIKE: How to analyze / mechanisms / methodological implications.

audience_dimensions.question: Is material technical detail preserved at an audience-appropriate level?

anchors.0_BEGINNER_LIKE: Language is simplified without deleting indispensable concepts.
anchors.1_INTERMEDIATE_LIKE: Central terminology and relationships are preserved.
anchors.2_ADVANCED_LIKE: Technical labels, granularity and nuance are preserved where material.

non_compensatory_checks.rule: Any known critical anchor contradiction, material qualifier loss, entity/period/scale/direction error or unsupported material claim prevents positive acceptance until resolved.
A material concept required by source/rubric cannot disappear merely to improve readability or apparent simplicity.
For ARTICLE, CAROUSEL or SHORT_VIDEO, validate native structure against canonical format contracts/tests rather than prose readability alone.

instructions: Assign a global audience label only after recording all five dimensions.
Do not compute the global label by simply averaging dimension numbers.
Set mixed_level_flag=true when dimensions conflict materially.
Use UNSCORABLE when no defensible dominant class exists.
A positive calibration example must pass factual and material-concept checks; format-native check must pass when applicable.
